launchCore: survival exploration combat with enemy pressure and visible action feedback
inventory equipment weapon armor and crafting interaction
mobile touch HUD menu inventory and contextual controls
articulated player NPC creature character motion with attack hit and recovery animation
state-adaptive BGM music and ambient audio while preserving owner-disabled SFX intent
combat VFX telegraphs camera response lighting materials and region readability
world regions resources landmarks crafting stations and discovery routes

releaseGates: actual Roblox Studio play with mobile-first input
perceptible character motion rather than root-only or whole-model bobbing
inventory and equipment state is authoritative and visibly confirmed
crafting and interaction input produces observable state feedback
BGM or intended ambience is actually playing and multi-sound mix uses SoundGroup organization
owner-disabled sound effects remain disabled unless the owner explicitly changes that decision

save and rejoin preserve stable progression and inventory where persistent

notes: This contract does not change gameplay balance, economy, save meaning, or network authority.
Web Magic Forest features already present in the canonical game are quality targets, not permission to invent unrelated Roblox systems.
Roblox implementation must use native Roblox motion, UI, audio, lighting and server/client responsibilities rather than literal Web code translation.
Sound objects, semantic asset atoms, source markers, or generic action buttons alone do not satisfy perceptible quality.
The owner previously disabled unwanted effect sounds; build-up must not re-enable them. Music and allowed ambience still require live runtime verification.
